deviations.claim_in_article: “In a way, it will stop the car’s ‘solo play-by-play’ and prevent a mismatch between actions and signals.”
deviations.issue: The article presents the replacement as certain to stop the malfunction and prevent mismatched signals. The Ledger confirms that BYD will replace the parts with improved ones, but does not verify that outcome; the Japanese source describes it as a measure intended to prevent the mismatch.
deviations.explanation: The wording strengthens a stated preventive measure into a definite result, adding an unverified causal outcome. This is stronger than the Japanese source’s framing as a countermeasure.

prior_issues_resolved.explanation: The one-line summary now says the pad may come off “in an extreme case,” linking the brake-light consequence to that condition.
